data.narrative:
Science Corporation is a Series B biotech company that has raised $230M to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a peer universe of 8 private companies and 3 public comparables in the Biotech & Health sector, with relevant private peers ranging from Eikon Therapeutics at $539M through Series C companies including Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and New Limit ($3.1B).

Two valuation methods proved applicable. Stage-progression analysis applied a 1.9x multiplier to the $230M total raised proxy, yielding $437M. Peer-median analysis across the 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produced a median valuation of $3.5B, with a range spanning $539M to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring using a sector P/S multiple of 8.1x could not be applied due to absence of target revenue disclosure, typical for private companies.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $371M (low) to $4.0B (high), with a median of $1.9B. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around whether Science Corporation tracks toward the lower end represented by Eikon Therapeutics or the higher multiples commanded by Series C-stage peers. Stage of funding, pipeline maturity, and near-term catalysts remain key variables in narrowing this range.
